cross_rail_recall_holdout.note: Every learned model scores each transaction in isolation, so a cross-rail leg looks ordinary to it. The deterministic DTL invariant compares AGGREGATE exposure against the delegated ceiling and is therefore holdout-independent: it does not need to have seen the attack family before.
